author: Manish Honap <mhonap@nvidia.com>
subject: NVIDIA: VR: SAUCE: vfio/cxl: Virtualize CXL DVSEC config writes
issue-severity-explanation: DVSEC writefn drops bytes outside the matched 16-bit register and clobbers neighbouring bytes on sub-word writes; readfn returns hardware values for byte reads of virtualized registers, producing user-visible inconsistency between guest config-space accesses and the vconfig shadow.
